name: Democracy
description: Elected councils, a free press, and endless debate. Strong liberties; slow to act.

name: Monarchy
description: A royal house whose claim goes back to the first colony ships. Loyal subjects, old traditions.

name: Corporate State
description: A board of directors governs, and citizens hold shares rather than votes. Rich, efficient, and not very sentimental.

name: Military Junta
description: The admiralty took power during a crisis and never gave it back. Strong fleets, short tempers.

name: Technocracy
description: Scientists and engineers rule by expertise. Brilliant research; unpopular with people who aren't experts.

name: Theocracy
description: The faithful govern according to doctrine carried from Old Earth. Devout, united, and suspicious of outsiders.
